Job Summary

The Paint Mixer & Colour Matcher is responsible for accurately formulating, mixing, tinting, and matching automotive paints to OEM factory specifications and existing vehicle finishes. This role ensures seamless colour accuracy, reduces rework and material waste, maintains mixing room equipment, and adheres strictly to health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards.
q: Proven minimum 2-5 years of experience in automotive paint mixing and colour matching.
Strong understanding of paint chemistry and application techniques.
Excellent attention to detail and a keen eye for colour.
Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.
Familiarity with safety protocols and practices in paint handling.
r: Prepare and mix automotive paint to match specific colour requirements.
Utilize colour-matching technology and tools to achieve precise colour formulations.
Collaborate with the automotive repair and refinishing teams to ensure quality control in paint application.
Maintain accurate records of paint formulations and colour match specifications.
Conduct regular quality checks on mixed paints to ensure consistency and compliance with industry standards.
Assist in inventory management of paint supplies and materials.
Stay updated on the latest trends and technologies in automotive paint mixing and color matching.
Provide exceptional customer service by addressing inquiries and offering expert advice on paint products.
